audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-3 are given to Ziggs though all three whys call them even/a stalemate, and Level 6 through 2+ items are 'Skill' though their whys say he zones and out-scales you outright — against a 14.29% win rate.
audit.why: Neither side kills before 4; from 6 his Mega Inferno Bomb and Satchel knockback deny the only engage Nautilus has.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2, 3 Skill; Levels 4-5, 6, First item and 2+ items Ziggs.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 1-3, your level 6 R, his level 6+ zoning and his first-item wave-clear spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge is tracked without its cooldown, and the advice never says the knockback also displaces Ziggs himself.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s and knocks Ziggs away too — so the window right after he uses it is the only time he has no self-peel. Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1, Hexplosive Minefield 16s flat, so the poke is constant and only the Satchel window is exploitable.
audit.corrected: Number Satchel at 20s and state that it displaces him as well.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then hook him on the Satchel Charge cooldown and chain the CC. Nautilus wins the Satchel Charge cooldown windows.
edits.after: He kites you out — survive the poke, then hook him inside the 20 seconds after Satchel Charge and chain your CC into a gank.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His knockback escape, 20s at rank 1 — walk him down in the whole window after he spends it.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Satchel knocks him away too — engage after it, when he cannot self-peel.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb is a 6s poke — take it and heal, never trade back.

notes: The kit file tags Satchel Charge with percentHealth, but Riot's own description says only magic damage plus knockback and the turret hexplode — treated as a tooltip-parsing misfire and NOT written into the page. Chart rows 0-2 and 4-6 flipped as one paired group to match the packet chart, the whys and the 14.29% win rate.
